item.title: unable to simply reset copilot chat editing session
item.body:
Type: Bug When I close chat editing session vscode always asks to either undo the edits to the files (which are not there) or keep the editing session. I always have to git stash my working tree, then close the editing session, find the "undoed" files, clean them up.
